additional_file_audit.name: 20261029_024431.txt
additional_file_audit.use: classification only; not calibration or blind validation of the scoped SameAB predictor

assessment.evaluation: development_leave_one_complete_sequence_pair_out; all B/head variants of a sequence pair are held together

calibration: Class-specific PMU only; all supplied stable development measurements; no FA latency target is fitted
classification: One SameAB BF16 BNSD UNSPLITK implementation; source tail conditions change counted work. Other kernel paths are classified for diagnostics and have no fitted latency model here.
identifiability: Within the stated linear workload basis, uniquely determined costs are distinguished from joint counter fits. Non-unique phase costs retain all feasible nonnegative decompositions and are propagated as timing ranges. No rates are borrowed across execution classes. These ranges exclude counter-fit error and missing physical effects; they are not confidence intervals or an accuracy guarantee.

next_validation.pass_rule: Every new numerically valid point must have absolute relative latency error at most 10%; failures and unavailable predictions cannot be dropped

phase_costs: Partial reconstruction from class-specific PMU constraints, with all feasible nonnegative rate decompositions retained; phase active sums are not isolated phase wall times
scope: SameAB BF16 BNSD UNSPLITK without dropout, attention mask, PSE, Rope or FAG; shape tails change counted work, not fitted shape exceptions

stage_measurement.interpretation: Device timestamps must distinguish submission, completion and waiting. Additional barriers or tracing affect the original overlap; isolated stage wall times cannot simply be added as kernel latency.

work_audit.fake_peer: General pairs Q tasks within each head and may send an empty peer message; these classes are separate and their empty-message pipeline cost is not yet modeled
work_audit.general_bmm2: Dense General outputs ND; TND General and SameAB output NZ
work_audit.l1_reuse: Paired clients share matching K/V windows; reuse is tracked separately for each S2 window
work_audit.s1_bmm2: Kernel C2 is FP32, including FP16 inputs; Host bmm2OutDtype is not the kernel output width
work_audit.tnd_sameab: Its ComputeConstexpr retains reduction width 8; TND General has a separate reduction-width branch
work_audit.traffic: Operand-byte estimates are checked against PMU; API reloads and memory transactions are not assumed proven by a matching Host route
work_audit.windowed_stats: Final K window writes max and sum; Vec2 consumes sum from UB
